goal: Deliver structured log entries to kernel consumers without requiring string parsing for metadata
Strip node-specific logging mechanisms from the embeddable kernel library interface
agreement: Strong support for rationalizing the logging API and adopting structured entries (ryanofsky)
Support following fixes for resource leaks and initialization bugs (w0xlt, musaHaruna)
Unresolved objection: using singletons introduces viral coupling across kernel components (purpleKarrot)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it decouples kernel logging from node-specific logging infrastructure
It provides structured log metadata to consumers and unblocks follow-up kernel modularity work
